subject: Staged commitment timetable and owning slate — MAP draft and owners

Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — MAP & go-live timetable

Thanks for the call this morning, everyone.

Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that reflects the milestones we discussed — it includes a proposed SOW sign date, a provisioning window, API integration, UAT, and a go-live week. High level:

- SOW sign: target Oct 1 (legal review still pending)
- Provisioning & keys: Oct 4–8
- Integration sprint (API + streaming): Oct 11–29
- Internal QA: Nov 1–5
- Customer UAT: Nov 8–12
- Go-live: Nov 15 (target)

Can you confirm who from Redwood would own each milestone (PM, integration lead, support handover) and whether the dates are realistic for your team? Also, please flag any blockers we should account for (e.g., sandbox access timing, SOC evidence).

I attached MAP_Solstice_v1.xlsx and a placeholder SOW (they're drafts). We can iterate during the week.

Thanks — Kelsey
Kelsey Tran

Hi Kelsey — thanks for the MAP and the clear dates. We ran this across engineering and onboarding and here are our proposed owners and a lightly adjusted timeline to account for sandbox access and credential rotation windows: 

Owners (Redwood):
- Project lead / delivery owner: Olga Petrov (olga.petrov@redwood.com) — overall MAP owner and weekly sync lead
- Integration & API owner: Priyom Das (priyom.das@redwood.com) — will own API keys, sample payloads, and test harnesses
- Onboarding & production readiness: Mina Haddad (mina.haddad@redwood.com) — will own staging account provisioning, runbooks, and go-live bridge

Proposed (adjusted) milestones: 
- SOW sign: target Oct 4 (we're allowing a 3-business-day buffer)
- Provisioning & keys (Redwood sandbox + Solstice test tenant): Oct 6–12
- Integration sprint (API + streaming): Oct 13–30
- Internal QA + performance baseline: Nov 2–6
- Customer UAT (week of): Nov 9–13
- Go-live: Nov 16 (preferred)

Risks / notes: 
- If Solstice needs a private model variant or quantized runtime for cost reasons, we need that decision by Oct 11 to avoid rework.
- SOC 2 checklist (we can deliver the requested controls) — please confirm the NDA/legal contact for evidence exchange.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm Solstice sign-off on SOW by Oct 4
2) Priyom to share API contract + sample cURL by Oct 6
3) Weekly 30-minute sync starting Oct 7 (Wednesdays 9 AM PT) — Olga to send calendar invite once dates confirmed

Quoting your MAP below for reference.

Quick technical notes from the integration team: 

- Sandbox access: For streaming/ws tests we need a service account token; Redwood can provision on Oct 6 but Solstice to confirm IP allowlist by Oct 5.
- API contract: I'll drop a public schema + example payloads to the shared sheet by Oct 6. Expect a small breaking change if Solstice wants chunked streaming acknowledgements — that would shift the integration sprint by ~3 business days.
- Performance baseline: To validate cost targets we'll run 3 perf runs during Nov 2–4; please confirm expected QPS and typical prompt lengths (avg tokens) so we can size the test.

Potential blocker: If Solstice requests on-prem/private deployment rather than hosted Redwood API the provisioning/time estimate increases by ~2 weeks due to onboarding the Private control plane. Please confirm preference ASAP.

I'll mark the API tasks in the MAP with owner tags (PRIY-API-01, PRIY-API-02) and post links in the sheet.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das

- IP allowlist: our DevOps team will provide the CIDR range by Oct 1 (we'll copy DevOps in a separate email)

- Expected QPS for baseline: 25–40 QPS, average prompt ~120 tokens; we'll also share a 20-example prompt set by Oct 1 for regression testing
